question: Why did Jehu tell the servants of Baal to check that no servants of the LORD were among them?
options: So the LORD's servants would not be offended
So that only servants of Baal would be there when he destroyed them
Because Baal priests asked him to
So he could count the people
explanation: Jehu wanted to make sure only the servants of Baal were inside, because he planned to destroy them.
